action.action-desc: Mr. Dunn (for himself and Mr. Cox of California) introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Agriculture

form.official-title: To clarify the clearing exemption for small financial institutions under the Commodity Exchange Act.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Small Financial Institution Certainty Act.
Section 2(h)(7)(C)(ii) of the Commodity Exchange Act (7 U.S.C. 2(h)(7)(C)(ii)) is amended to read as follows:

clause.text: Such definition shall not include any—

subclause.text: insured depository institution with total assets of $10,000,000,000 or less;
farm credit system institution with total assets of $10,000,000,000 or less;
credit union with total assets of $10,000,000,000 or less;
bank holding company (as defined in section 2 of the Bank Holding Company Act of 1956) that has aggregated assets, including the assets of its subsidiaries, of $10,000,000,000 or less; or
savings and loan holding company (as defined in section 10 of the Home Owners’ Loan Act of 1933) that has aggregated assets, including the assets of its subsidiaries, of $10,000,000,000 or less.
